event: Nala walks three minutes down the towpath to Hobb's landing.
The bargeman meets her at the plank: lean, sun-browned, two fingers gone from his left hand.
"Jory Pell, master of the Wend Maid. You'll be the Board's hunter, at last, with that sword."
On the other barge, the Pike, a crew of three watch from the deck in silence.
"It rose under my bow at dusk two days back and took my bowman Dickon clean off the deck."
"His bolts skipped off its back like hail off slate."
He jerks his chin at the stove-in hulk across the pool. "The Heron. Stove in at dawn a week ago."
"Near noon on sunny days it hauls out on the weir stone to lie in the sun. I've watched it."
"Keep off the pool's edge, mind. It took the miller's dog off the bank a week back."
"Where it lives, I'd guess the pool. Past that, it's anyone's guess."
"Both crews will add a gold between us if it dies. We need to get downriver."
Jory squints up at the sun climbing over the weir. "Today's sunny enough, I'd say."
